what_happened.what: Investigated and fixed fetch-chain-data Jenkins job failure. Root cause: Jenkinsfile wasn't loading .env secrets file even though it existed at /var/jenkins_home/secrets/0/.env. Added SECRETS_DIR env var and .env copy step to match production Jenkinsfile.

Clarified repository organization: maybelle-config holds infrastructure (ansible/docker), arthel holds CI integration (Jenkinsfiles/jobs). Renamed deployment/ → integration/ in arthel to reflect actual purpose.
Created PR #304 to cryptograss/arthel with directory rename and .env fix. Had to rebase to exclude unrelated show_and_set_data.js commit from jMyles fork.

Deployed maybelle but Jenkins job still used old deployment/ path. Discovered job definitions copy task in ansible was missing notify handler for restart. Also found globalNodeProperties in wrong jenkins.yml section causing JCasC validation error.

Fixed two ansible issues: moved globalNodeProperties from unclassified to jenkins section, added notify handler to job definitions copy task. Jenkins restart triggered, fetch-chain-data jobs #1307/1308/1309 now passing.
Discovered production builds failing at test stage. ticket_stub_generation_test expecting 3 fake stubs but receiving 0. Flagged as separate issue from infrastructure fixes.
Session compacted at Wickenburg Bluegrass Festival. Context exhausted after successful Jenkins work.
Session resumed from compact. Magent oriented and ready. Checked out last-things-from-justins-laptop branch to investigate ticketstub test and explore rabbithole (chartifacts player).

Ticketstub test investigation: same failure on last-things-from-justins-laptop branch. Found root cause: setstone_utils.js only generates fake stubs for three hardcoded shows (Burza #4, Bike Jesus, Porcupine 2025), but test uses ETHDam (0-22447747) which isn't in list.

Began exploration of rabbithole (chartifacts player). Discovered webamp-based player with real-time solo visualization, NFT chartifact integration, ensemble display, parts chart with musician tracking, timeline-driven architecture using timestamps or section names.
